subtitle: 生病無法上課，寫信向老師請假
task: You are sick and cannot attend your English class tomorrow. Write a short email to your teacher, Ms. Parker. Explain why you will be absent, apologize, and ask how you can catch up.
taskZh: 你生病了，明天無法去上英文課。寫一封簡短的 email 給 Parker 老師：說明缺席原因、表示歉意，並詢問要怎麼補上進度。
focus: 語氣禮貌：先道歉再說明原因
清楚寫出缺席日期與原因
主動提出補上進度的方法

en: I am sorry, but I will not be able to come to class tomorrow. I have a high fever, and the doctor told me to stay home for two days. I have attached my doctor's note to this email.
Could you please tell me what I will miss? I will read the chapter and finish the homework before the next class.
zh: 很抱歉，我明天無法去上課。我發高燒，醫生要我在家休息兩天。我已將醫生證明附在這封信中。
可以請您告訴我明天的上課內容嗎？我會在下次上課前讀完那一章並完成作業。

patterns.pattern: I am sorry, but I will not be able to …
patterns.example: I am sorry, but I will not be able to come to class tomorrow.

patterns.pattern: I have attached … to this email.
patterns.example: I have attached my doctor's note to this email.
Could you please tell me what I will miss?

patterns.zh: 請假信常用的結尾感謝語

parts: The doctor told me to stay home.
combine.answer: I have a high fever, and the doctor told me to stay home.
I will read the chapter and finish the homework.

paraphrase.sentence: I will not be able to come to class tomorrow.
Could you please tell me what I will miss?
answers: Could you let me know what we will cover?
Would you mind telling me what I will miss?
